name: Git Safety Guard
description: Blocks branch/commit/push and destructive git operations during migration unless explicitly requested

then.prompt: If this command contains git commit, git push, git checkout, git switch, git branch, git reset --hard, git clean -f, or git rebase, it is BLOCKED unless the user explicitly asked for that git operation in their message. Migration changes stay on the current branch, uncommitted. Build, test, and read-only git commands (status, diff, log) proceed normally.
